vocabulary.example: I bought a souvenir for my mom.
I would like to visit Paris someday.
It was the best trip of my life.

grammar.point: Superlatives for describing experiences + would like to
grammar.point_ko: 경험을 묘사하는 최상급 + would like to
grammar.explanation_en: Superlatives (the best, the most beautiful) are perfect for describing standout travel memories. Use 'would like to' (more polite than 'want to') to talk about travel wishes: 'I would like to visit Rome.'
grammar.explanation_ko: 최상급(the best, the most beautiful)은 특별했던 여행 기억을 묘사하기에 딱 좋습니다. 여행 소망을 말할 때는 'want to'보다 더 정중한 'would like to'를 씁니다: 'I would like to visit Rome.'(로마를 방문하고 싶어요)

examples.en: This was the most beautiful beach I have visited.
examples.ko: 이곳은 제가 방문한 곳 중 가장 아름다운 해변이었어요.

examples.en: I would like to travel to Europe next year.
That was the best vacation ever!

reading.title: A Dream Vacation
reading.text: Last month, I finally took the trip I always wanted. I flew to Thailand and stayed at a small hotel near the beach. The beach was the most beautiful place I had ever seen. I went sightseeing every day and bought souvenirs for my family. It was the best vacation of my life.
reading.text_ko: 지난달, 저는 드디어 항상 원하던 여행을 다녀왔어요. 태국으로 날아가 해변 근처의 작은 호텔에 묵었어요. 그 해변은 제가 본 곳 중 가장 아름다운 곳이었어요. 매일 관광을 다녔고 가족을 위한 기념품도 샀어요. 제 인생 최고의 휴가였어요.

explanation.en: The text says 'I flew to Thailand.'
The text says 'a small hotel near the beach.'
The text says 'It was the best vacation of my life.'
explanation.ko: 본문에 'the best vacation of my life'라고 나옵니다.
